description: Persist a Kyron Medical appointment after the patient confirms date, time, and doctor on the phone. Call this ONLY when the patient has agreed to a specific slot. Requires patient details from the linked web chat session (session_id in call metadata) OR pass doctor_id + patient fields if your flow collects them on the call.
name: book_kyron_appointment

doctor_id.description: UUID of the doctor from the system (preferred if known).

doctor_name.description: Doctor display name if UUID unknown, e.g. Dr Smith, Dr Patel.

send_sms_reminder.description: True if the patient asked for SMS reminders.

session_id.description: Web chat session id if not already on the call metadata.
